name: Well Chip Group Berhad
overview: Well Chip Group Berhad 在 2026 年没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，也没有公布新的合约或订单。最多发行 120,000,000 股新股，以及寻求股东对经常性关联方交易的授权。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收为 71,613,000 令吉，同比增长 8.7%；净利润为 23,930,000 令吉，同比增长 17.9%。
overview_en: Well Chip Group Berhad had no announcements in 2026 involving expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of any business segment, nor any new contracts or orders. The main corporate activities were a proposed renounceable rights issue of up to 120,000,000 new shares and seeking shareholder mandates for recurrent related party transactions. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was RM71,613,000, up 8.7% year-on-year; net profit was RM23,930,000, up 17.9% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及供股集资和关联方交易授权，没有披露具体业务板块的运营变化。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly cover a rights issue for fundraising and mandates for related party transactions, with no disclosed operational changes in specific business segments.

actions.title: RENOUNCEABLE RIGHTS ISSUE OF UP TO 120,000,000 NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN WELL CHIP GROUP BERHAD ("WELL CHIP" OR THE "COMPANY") ("WELL CHIP SHAR
actions.text: 以每股 1.00 令吉发行最多 120,000,000 股新股。
actions.text_en: Proposed renounceable rights issue of up to 120,000,000 new shares at RM1.00 per share on the basis of 1 rights share for every 5 existing shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟召开特别股东大会寻求股东批准经常性关联方交易的新授权。
actions.text_en: Intends to seek shareholders' approval for a new mandate for recurrent related party transactions at an EGM.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 披露 2025 年 6 月 1 日至 2026 年 5 月 31 日期间的经常性关联方交易，累计金额超过 1% 比率。
actions.text_en: Disclosed recurrent related party transactions for the period 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026, with aggregate consideration exceeding the 1% percentage ratio.
